text.tspan: Utah is home to Pando, a colony of about
47,000 quaking aspen trees that all share a single root
system. Pando is one of the largest single organisms
by mass on Earth, but ecologists are worried that its
growth is declining in part because of grazing by
animals. The ecologists say that strong fences could
prevent deer from eating young trees and help Pando
